title: Eli Lilly and Company (LLY) — Institutional Investment Monograph
primer: Eli Lilly and Company (NYSE: LLY) leads global metabolic care through Mounjaro, Zepbound, and newly approved oral GLP-1 Foundayo. Strong Oncology, Immunology, and Neuroscience franchises lifted TTM sales to $86.46 billion with 31.61% ROIC. At the November 18, 2026 close of $1,382.75 (26.75x Forward P/E, 0.79 PEG), LLY sits +6.70% above its 10W EMA ($1,295.91) with 1.24:1 CMP R:R. We assign WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (Tier 1) to enter at $1,283.94–$1,323.04 (2.05:1 R:R) with a $1,158.45 stop and $1,660.00 Base target (+20.05%).
holding_rationale: LLY is not currently held in the consolidated US brokerage accounts (Schwab + Robinhood) per the 2026-11-18 positions ledger; therefore 0 shares are held or sold.

holding_alerts.instruction: Initiate 50% of Tier-1 target position when LLY pulls back into the $1,283.94–$1,323.04 support zone (2.05:1 R:R vs. $1,158.45 stop).

holding_alerts.trigger: Entry Tranche 2 at 10W EMA / Lower Support ($1,283.94–$1,295.91)
holding_alerts.instruction: Deploy remaining 50% tranche on a controlled test of the 10-week EMA ($1,295.91) on light volume.
Exit full position on a weekly close below $1,158.45 (below 30-week SMA $1,180.13 and 40-week EMA $1,154.78).

redeployment_plan.capital_source: Next marginal US equity capital unit (LLY is currently NOT_HELD; evaluating LLY at $1,382.75 vs. cash and outside peers in a Downtrend regime).

destinations.rationale: With the S&P 500 in a Downtrend (44.4% > 50-DMA, 8 distribution days) and LLY at $1,382.75 offering 1.24:1 CMP R:R (< 1.50:1 hurdle), hold 100% in USD Cash until LLY pulls back to $1,283.94–$1,323.04.
destinations.entry_condition: Deploy into LLY on pullback to $1,283.94–$1,323.04 support zone (2.05:1 R:R).

destinations.rationale: Tier-1 Compounder Pass (31.61% ROIC, 26.75x Fwd P/E, 0.79 PEG) in Stage 2; 1.24:1 R:R at $1,382.75 CMP improves to 2.05:1 in the $1,283.94–$1,323.04 support zone.
destinations.entry_condition: Enter in $1,283.94–$1,323.04 support zone with $1,158.45 hard stop.

destinations.rationale: Amgen ($443.89, Stage 2, 17.59x Fwd P/E) offers MariTide optionality, but slower organic growth and 1.25:1 asymmetry (< 1.50:1 hurdle).
destinations.entry_condition: No allocation; revisit only if MariTide Phase 3 data shifts growth trajectory or price pulls back to $395–$410.
